_comment: Elegoo TPU 72D preset derived from the vendor TPU 95A profile (ElegooSlicer ships none). Temperatures from Elegoo's TPU 72D page: nozzle 210-240 C, bed 30-45 C, dry 70 C for 8 h. Speeds stay at the 95A values; 72D feeds better and can go faster once a coupon prints clean.
name: Elegoo TPU 72D @ECC2
